title: Structured Response is the wider producer boundary
summary: The wider Structured Response envelope is the pre-flattening producer point. Structured Utterance remains the language-specific projection for utterance structure, generation intent and information-use lineage; cognitive effects are sibling proposals from the same response and require separate Cognitive Admission before becoming durable state.
invariants: Preserve structure at the point where it is known rather than rediscovering it from rendered prose.
Structured Utterance owns utterance structure, generation intent and information-use lineage, not project plans, durable facts or coding episodes.
Cognitive effects are sibling proposals from Structured Response, not additional Structured Utterance authority.
Model output cannot self-promote to TOOL_VERIFIED or durable cognitive authority.
Action intention is not action evidence; planned completion is not observed completion.
Privacy and retention policy apply before durable cognitive admission.

provenance.claim: Structured Response is the existing strict producer boundary and controlled cognitive proposals may accompany normal response-plan data.
Cognitive effects are proposals and are sibling projections; Structured Utterance remains language-specific.
CognitiveAdmissionService is the authority boundary and model proposals cannot self-promote authority or completion evidence.
